status: Owner approved storyboard with transient/nonfatal and offscreen changes; implemented with procedural shader and existing lunar UI
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept.
Create ONE polished 2x2 storyboard sheet for approval of an isometric fantasy game's throne-damage / defeat / retry sequence. The provided first image is the exact existing blue soul-flame throne under an ice-blue dome, on concentric stone rings. Preserve that object identity. The second image is the existing game's pearl ceramic, plum, silver and turquoise HUD style; preserve its visual language, without adding systems. These are project-owned reference images, not assets to trace verbatim.
Each panel is a widescreen actual-game-like frame, same isometric camera and same small blue domed throne placed at slightly right of center in a gray stone defense road and soft painted grassy surroundings. It is THE THRONE that is hit by creeps. White rays must originate at the dome's soul, not at the screen center, and extend radially all the way beyond screen edges. Show progressive destruction of reality/screen, like bright glass/matrix fractures; no green code, no black crack lines, no blood. White luminous seams and broad soft beams. The world remains readable on early hits. Do not depict broken physical monitor hardware.
Top left: first damage, a restrained brief white burst with 3–5 thin radial light fissures anchored exactly at dome, mostly readable world and HUD.
Top right: accumulated damage, denser branching white screen fractures in several directions, wider light wedges, retaining plenty of readable world.
Bottom left: final catastrophic hit, white fissures splitting view into fading polygonal fragments, pearl light flooding almost the entire frame, dome still visible as origin, UI disappears beneath light. Show progression, not an arbitrary explosion.
Bottom right: transition has finished to a FULL clean pearl-white screen. No visible world, cracks or throne remain. Restrained elegant centered retry UI with plum text and subtle turquoise accent in the existing lunar fantasy style. Russian text verbatim: title "Ещё одна попытка"; subtitle "Вернитесь к подготовке и измените исход"; prominent button "Повторить волну"; small supporting line "Состояние до волны • Полное время подготовки". Clear readable sans-serif Cyrillic. No new currency or penalty, no option to restart the entire game, no lore, no health bars added.
Overall: high-quality cohesive production storyboard, four equal panels with thin quiet dividers. No explanatory text, English labels, watermarks, stage numbers or extra panels. This is a concept for a procedural effect and UI, not a static runtime screen texture.
authorship_and_rights: AI-generated concept derived from project-owned references; no third-party artwork. Concept only, not runtime-ready texture.
constraints: Per-hit white radial fractures from existing throne dome; cumulative HP-loss intensity; full white defeat then retry pre-wave checkpoint with full preparation. No new penalty or progression.
approval: Да, только нужно чтобы через какое-то время эти разломанные экраны пропали. Owner requires expiring nonfatal cracks, a small shake including when the dome is offscreen, visible-dome radial fractures, global fatal whiteout/retry.
runtime_assets: No concept pixels shipped. Native ThroneFracture shader, Stage3DefeatSettings and existing original dome/HUD assets implement the approved direction.
